entity: Department of Health, Education, and Welfare
stance_basis: direct statement that proposed highway construction does not appear to represent a hazard to public health and safety
summary: The Department of Health, Education, and Welfare reviewed the health aspects of the proposed Lincoln Highway project and found no hazard to public health and safety, offering no objections or conditions. Their comment was brief and entirely non-adverse, resulting in a concurrence from the project preparers.
complaint_summary: The Department of Health, Education, and Welfare reviewed the health aspects of the project and found that the proposed highway construction does not appear to represent a hazard to public health and safety.
